pages.title: Water Has a Point
pages.text: Water weapons offer different ways to control a fight.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Obtain tools through real Deep One trades. Hold Ortholance to charge, fire Sea Staff bolts or summon temporary allies with Conch. Ink Bombs blind while Glow Ink Bombs glow; these are not wave damage.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Transfer water with a redstone Drain and ascend with a Floater. The Drain needs liquid above and empty space below. Gossamer Worm Bioluminessence makes Floaters, underwater torches and Glowing potions. Light and glowing creatures attract Hullbreakers.
